description: This Java class 'RomChecksum' provides methods to calculate and validate checksums within a ROM image. It operates on byte arrays, computing checksums over specified memory ranges, and verifies integrity by comparing stored checksum values against computed sums.

classes.name: RomChecksum
classes.description: Utility class for calculating and validating checksums in ROM data.

methods.name: calculateRomChecksum
methods.description: Calculates checksums over specified regions of the byte array and updates the checksum values in the ROM data.

methods.name: validateRomChecksum
methods.description: Validates checksums within the ROM data, returning a status indicating if all checksums are valid or specify the position of an invalid checksum.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Private helper method that computes the sum of bytes within a range and compares with expected checksum.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Private helper method that computes the checksum for a specified address range.
